title: Saavedra's Rook
setup: Your pawn queens on c8 with the black king cornered on a1 and its rook watching from d4.
hint: The black king is down to its last corner. Ask what a brand new queen would do to that fact.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{c8=Q}} is answered by {{Rc4+}}, and Qxc4 is stalemate, since the king on a1 has nowhere to go. {{c8=R}} threatens Rc1 mate instead, and after Ra4 White plays Kb3 and wins the rook. This is the Saavedra position, published in 1895.
